run_evaluate_test: run evaluate_test to evaluate a mesh reconstruction model on a ShapeNet test dataset with optional visualization
run_evaluate_test_p2m: run evaluate_test_p2m to evaluate a mesh model using Pixel2Mesh metrics with 0.57 rescaling factor
run_evaluate_split: run evaluate_split to report validation performance during training with configurable prediction limits
review_evaluate_test: review evaluate_test to understand how Chamfer-L2, normal consistency, and F1 scores are computed per class
refactor_evaluate_split: refactor evaluate_split to store predicted mesh vertices and faces for a specified number of predictions
